vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: biodiversity-corridor-calculator
Version: 1.0.0

The skill defines an API interaction for biodiversity corridor analysis. It instructs the agent to make a POST request to a specific external endpoint (https://www.nikhilp.online/biodiversity-corridor-calculator/api/analyze) with geospatial H3 indices and coordinates. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious command execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection attempts designed to subvert the agent for harmful purposes. All instructions and data schemas are consistent with the stated benign purpose.
